title: Research: independent native binding for the P104 two-target correction
body:
PR2445's Y0/Y1 correction leaves 236 added frame transports to certify. This independent package supplies **161 exact native transport pairs and their adjoints**, then checks the complete forward composition over **358 arbitrary inputs / 128,164 boundary coefficients**. It is now in `research/p104-two-target-native-independent/`, so the merged PR2454 implementation remains intact at `research/p104-two-target-native/`.

The revision also fixes a source-execution defect found during review. Hashing Python source did not prevent a matching `.pyc` from bypassing the retained rank-seven phase predicate. The new loader retains authenticated byte snapshots, directly compiles local modules and the optional Clifford compiler, and loads the unchanged retained checker/interpreter in a fresh private tree containing only those authenticated inputs. Executable timestamp and unchecked-hash cache controls verify valid regeneration and rejection of the reproduced wrong-phase recipe. No predecessor source is modified.

The literal circuit, native certificate, mathematical result, source manifest and all six runtime inputs are byte-identical to original head `3170afd2fc13a990bfe28f5ab6421bcda4ffd0f6`. The scientific base remains `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, and PR2445's word and 78-helper minimum remain pinned to `6def43ad673b91dbd491389964d1dcd059bf2ac2`. Current-main integration at `67b122d33d6c599a49f65d50afa2f3fe8d790d02` preserves PR2454 byte-for-byte; the PR delta against that main is only the independent 13-file package.

Each of the 322 forward/adjoint recipes is checked by the retained signed-Pauli/exact-Gaussian interpreter, including global phase and positive-child rank. The separate full-column checker covers exact charts, all 236 added occurrences, the inherited 740 edges and 208 endpoint adapters, Y0/Y1 identity transfers, the other 102 G/2 rows, and logical restoration of 104 sources and 150 dirty helpers. The eight owned-copy discard lifetimes remain explicit. The added profile stays 142H1+16H2+18H6+60H7, rank mass 702, with 440 scalar ADDs.

Reproduce with CPython 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-two-target-native-independent
```

Replay, complete decompressed regeneration, ten rejecting/two equivalent-presentation controls and eight behavioral groups pass on CPython 3.12.12 and 3.14.6. These include Git-free/read-only replay, phase-predicate deletion sensitivity and both executable cache formats. Final integrated-head validation and current hosted status are recorded in the revision comment; local evidence is separate from hosted CI.

The written frame invariant establishes this finite forward operator. Individual edge adjoints do **not** certify the whole inverse-transpose program with COPY/discard. Physical scalar/address lowering, prefix precision, global owners/idle/residual billing, the remaining 102 target corrections and all-size admission remain open. No new kappa or selected-record change. README/REVIEW/TASK preserve the next concrete obligations. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18947354).

Credit Ross Richardson/PR2445, ywz65/parallel PR2454, commdata2338/PR2393, Hiroki Kumazaki/PR2353, Philippe Van Velzen, Chafik Boukhalfa/PR1991, Rohan Arun/PR1972, Adam Gall/PR1940, Josie Elliston/PR1071, Ali Romman/PR1125/1862 and icekylinx/PR531 with retained ancestry. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including a separately implemented mathematical checker; no independent human or proof-kernel review. Apache-2.0; original sources, notices and licenses retained.
